'''''Star Wars: Jedi — The Dark Side''''' is a five-part [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series written by [[Scott Allie]]. Set in [[53 BBY/Legends|53 BBY]], the story arc follows [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Xanatos]] as they are [[Mission to Telos (53 BBY)|sent]] by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to prevent [[Telosian Civil War|civil war]] from erupting on Xanatos's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Telos IV]]. The [[Jedi — The Dark Side 1|first issue]] was released on May 18, 2011.<ref name="MTV">{{WebCite|url=http://splashpage.mtv.com/2011/01/27/star-wars-jedi-the-dark-side-comic-preview-scott-allie|text=Announcement|work=MTV.com|archivedate=20110128171502}}</ref>

The story arc is an adaptation of the backstory described in ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Dark Rival]]'', although it follows a very different storyline.
